test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about the December 2024 appointments to the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) is INCORRECT?

options.text: Justice V Ramasubramanian was appointed as the Chairperson of NHRC.
Shri Priyank Kanoongo was appointed as the Secretary General of NHRC.
Justice (Dr.) Bidyut Ranjan Sarangi joined NHRC as a Member.
The appointments were made by the President of India in December 2024.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Priyank Kanoongo was appointed as the Secretary General of NHRC**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) is an independent statutory body established under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993.
 
• Justice V Ramasubramanian's appointment as Chairperson aligns with the NHRC's mandate of appointing a retired Chief Justice of India or a Judge of the Supreme Court as Chairperson.
 
• Justice (Dr.) Bidyut Ranjan Sarangi has been confirmed as a Member of NHRC in December 2024.
 
• All appointments to the NHRC, including Chairperson and Members, are made by the President of India based on recommendations from a committee chaired by the Prime Minister.
 
• Shri Priyank Kanoongo is currently the Chairperson of the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR) and has not been appointed as the Secretary General of NHRC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NHRC Composition:**

 
 
• The NHRC consists of a Chairperson, Members, and Ex-officio Members, including Chairpersons of National Commissions like SC/ST, Women, Minorities, etc.
 
• The Chairperson is typically a retired Chief Justice or a Judge of the Supreme Court.
 
 
 
• **Appointment Process:**
 
 
• Appointments are made by the President of India based on recommendations from a high-level committee chaired by the Prime Minister.
 
• The committee includes the Union Home Minister, Leaders of Opposition in Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha, and others.
 
 
 
• **Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993:**
 
 
• This Act provides the legal framework for establishing the NHRC and State Human Rights Commissions.
 
• The Act aims to protect and promote human rights guaranteed by the Constitution and embodied in international covenants.
 
 
 
• **Role of NHRC:**
 
 
• NHRC investigates human rights violations and recommends measures to ensure compliance with constitutional and legal rights.
 
• It submits annual reports to the President of India and can intervene in court cases involving human rights violations.
